subject: MAP: SilverLine Health - Integration build milestones & owners (SDK, streaming, tool-calls)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@silverlinehealth.com>, Avery Kline <avery.k@silverlinehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (integration milestones)

Hi Jordan / Avery — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a first-pass mutual action plan item focused on the Integration build milestone (SDK + streaming + tool-calls / structured outputs). Please confirm owners and timelines below so I can push an updated MAP into the doc.

High-level objective: ship a production-grade Redwood SDK integration enabling streaming + tool-calling and structured outputs for SilverLine’s clinician assistant by end of Q2.

Proposed integration build milestones (owners / target dates / deps):
1) SDK onboarding + example app (owner: Priyom Das) — target: 2027-05-21. Deliverables: sample SDK integration repo, auth flow docs, quickstart. Dependencies: SilverLine API access and initial test account.
2) Streaming & KV cache integration + tool-calling hooks (owner: Rishi Malhotra) — target: 2027-06-04. Deliverables: continuous streaming session, KV prefix caching for recent context, example tool-call adapter. Dependencies: infra quota approval, dev environment parity.
3) Structured outputs & evals (owner: Evelyn Hart) — target: 2027-06-18. Deliverables: structured JSON schemas for clinical notes, eval prompt set, regression guardrails. Dependencies: sample prompts and annotation guidance from SilverLine.

Open items / asks for SilverLine:
- Confirm API credentials and test sandbox by 2027-05-07.
- Provide a sample of typical prompts/messages (10-15) for the structured-output schema by 2027-05-14.
- Confirm target close date for MAP (we proposed 2027-06-30 in the call) — is that OK?

Attachments: silverline_map_v0.3.xlsx (MAP v0.3), api_spec_excerpt.pdf (excerpt of your API), screenshot_kv_cache.png (example).

Next steps: if you confirm owners/timelines I’ll update the MAP doc and create an actionable task list in HS-72391 and invite relevant ICs. If anything below needs to shift, say so and we’ll re-align.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: silverline_map_v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet), api_spec_excerpt.pdf
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@silverlinehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T13:45:12-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (integration milestones)

Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap. This looks good overall. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Sequence length / cost sensitivity: our longest clinician prompt runs ~1.8k tokens; we need an idea of cost/latency tradeoffs if we keep full context vs. a sliding KV window. Can Rishi advise?
- Timeline: June 30 for MAP close sounds realistic as long as SDK onboarding is quick. Can we accelerate the SDK sample to the week of 5/10? That would help our SRE team start tests earlier.
- Pre-reqs: we’ll provision sandbox credentials by 5/05 and share a sample prompt set by 5/12.

Also — can you attach the MAP spreadsheet with a short change log? I received the drive link but not the file.

Best,
Jordan Meyers
Head of Integrations, SilverLine Health
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@silverlinehealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (integration milestones)

Jordan — quick tech note on sequence/kv and cadence:

- For ~1.8k token prompts we recommend using a bounded KV cache (sliding window) plus prefix caching for system + steady instructions; this preserves low p99 latency while keeping cost reasonable. I attached a small screenshot showing expected token split and where KV hits help (screenshot_kv_cache.png).
- Priyom: if we can ship the SDK sample the week of 5/10, I can stagger infra provisioning and reserve burst capacity for 5/17–5/24 to support early load tests. Priyom — can you confirm you have bandwidth for a 5/10 sample deliverable?
- Dev: can you prepare a lightweight tool-call adapter (HTTP webhook example) so SilverLine can see pattern for external system calls? Target prototype by 5/24.

I’ll plan to run a short tech working session (30 min) the week after SDK sample lands. Evelyn — if Jordan/Avery confirm sandbox dates we can lock a slot.

—Rishi
Senior Infra Eng, Redwood Inference
Attachments: screenshot_kv_cache.png

Date: 2027-04-29T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: MAP update: SilverLine integration milestones (v0.4) — confirmed owners & revised dates

Jordan / Avery — thanks for the fast replies and for confirming the sandbox timing. I’ve updated the MAP to reflect the accelerated SDK sample and Rishi’s infra notes. Summary of changes (v0.4):

- SDK onboarding + example app — owner: Priyom Das — revised target: 2027-05-14 (moved earlier to support SRE testing).
- Streaming + KV cache + tool-call adapter — owner: Rishi Malhotra / Dev Patel (infra + adapter) — target: 2027-05-24 (prototype) / 2027-06-04 (stabilize).
- Structured outputs + evals — owner: Evelyn Hart — target: 2027-06-18.
- MAP target close: 2027-06-30 (confirmed).

Action items I’ve taken: uploaded MAP v0.4 spreadsheet to the Drive link and attached a local copy (silverline_map_v0.3.xlsx — note: v0.4 is in Drive), created HubSpot record HS-72391 and added milestones, scheduled a 30-min tech working session for 2027-05-26 10:00 PT (invite to follow).

Requests for SilverLine: please share sandbox creds by 2027-05-05 and prompt samples by 2027-05-12 so Priyom and Rishi can run the first smoke tests.

If that works I’ll lock the MAP and send a short MOP (milestone operating plan) with owners, acceptance criteria, and test checklist.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: silverline_map_v0.3.xlsx (local copy; canonical v0.4 in Drive), api_spec_excerpt.pdf
